1 · Intro

When to use it.

Use Costing for Persons to enter or change where an assignment, or a single pay element, is charged. In many areas the finance partner does this, so confirm who owns it in your department.

Get the COA or POET string from your finance partner before you start.

Use this whenThe default won't work and the person or a payment needs specific costing.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Before you submit

The same four checks on every pay-impacting transaction. Draft: the owner for this area confirms anything marked To confirm.

Attach

  • Prior periods: the Retro Costing Request Form (Salary), sent to the Research Finance Team Required
  • Cost transfer memo, if an externally funded grant is affected Required

Check

Read every field back against the source document: person, effective date, position, hours, pay, and costing.

  • Effective As-of Date is the first day of the pay period the costing should start.
  • The lines total 100%.
  • The COA or POET string came from your finance partner.
  • You ran the HCM Cost Allocation Verification Plan report afterward.

To confirmWhere the Retro Change Cutoff is published. It is not on the HR/Payroll Calendar.

Cutoff

Current and future changes: enter by the HCM Transaction Cutoff. Prior periods: send the Retro Costing Request Form (Salary) to the Research Finance Team by the Retro Change Cutoff, usually two business days earlier.

Who does what

  • Who starts it: You or your finance partner. Confirm who owns it in your department.
  • Who approves: To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.
  • What happens next: Oracle uses the costing in effect on the Pay Period End Date and does not prorate.

Watch-outs

  • Costing applies to a full pay period. Oracle uses the costing in effect on the Pay Period End Date and does not prorate.
  • Current and future changes: enter by the HCM Transaction Cutoff.
  • Prior periods (retro): also submit the Retro Costing Request Form (Salary) to the Research Finance Team by the Retro Change Cutoff, usually two business days before the HCM Transaction Cutoff. Include a cost transfer memo if an externally funded grant is affected.
  • Vanderbilt's guide is dated 01/27/2022, before the Redwood screens. Confirm field names in a recorded demo.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: How do I manage person costing? (opens in a new tab)
  • Oracle: Set Up Person Level Costing (opens in a new tab)

HCM Academy job aid · Costing Management

Enter costing for a person

Use when: The default won't work and the person or a payment needs specific costing. · System: Oracle HCM (Costing for Persons)

  1. Open Costing for Persons.
  2. Search the person with Advanced Search and the right Effective As-of Date.
    • Use the first day of the current or future pay period the costing should start (the Pay Period Start Date on the payroll calendar).
    • Past date, such as a new hire's start: use that date. The standard path only offers today forward.
    • Prior pay periods (retro) also need the Retro Costing Request Form. See the watch-outs.
  3. Select the person, then select the Assignment on the left.
  4. Click Actions > Create and choose what to cost.
    • Create Costing: the whole assignment.
    • Create Costing of Element: one type of pay, such as a bonus. Then pick the Element Name; use the code ending in Earnings Results (for example, BON Earnings Results). Codes are listed in the HCM Award Compensation Resource Guide on the HCM Specialist resource page.
  5. Enter the effective date and click OK.
  6. Add a costing line: click Actions > Create, or the + icon.
  7. Enter each line. Percentages must total 100%.
    • COA string: Entity, Net Asset Class (for example, 05), Financial Unit, Program and Activity (000 if unused), VU_Function. Use default zeros for InterEntity (000), Future 2 (0), and the POET fields (0000).
    • Account: leave it blank for an assignment (payroll fills it). For an element, enter it: 5110 faculty, 5120 staff, 5130 student.
    • POET string (grants): in the COA fields always enter the payroll clearing string 380.05.38600.5140.000.000.000.VUI.0, then Project Number, Organization, Expenditure Type (SalFac, SalStaff, or SalStud), and Task.
    • Leave Allocation Type blank.
  8. Click Submit.
  9. Click Done, then run the HCM Cost Allocation Verification Plan report.

Before you submit

  • Attach: Prior periods: the Retro Costing Request Form (Salary), sent to the Research Finance Team (required). Cost transfer memo, if an externally funded grant is affected (required).
  • Check: Effective As-of Date is the first day of the pay period the costing should start. The lines total 100%. The COA or POET string came from your finance partner. You ran the HCM Cost Allocation Verification Plan report afterward.
  • Cutoff: By the HCM Transaction Cutoff. Prior periods: the retro form by the Retro Change Cutoff, usually two business days earlier.

Watch-outs

  • Costing applies to a full pay period. Oracle uses the costing in effect on the Pay Period End Date and does not prorate.
  • Current and future changes: enter by the HCM Transaction Cutoff.
  • Prior periods (retro): also submit the Retro Costing Request Form (Salary) to the Research Finance Team by the Retro Change Cutoff, usually two business days before the HCM Transaction Cutoff. Include a cost transfer memo if an externally funded grant is affected.
  • Vanderbilt's guide is dated 01/27/2022, before the Redwood screens. Confirm field names in a recorded demo.
